generatedProse.practice-connection: Across the School of Sport, finding and using sources well is the engine of every literature review, lab report, coaching analysis and dissertation you write. An argument is only as sound as the search behind it: wide enough to be fair to the evidence, sharp enough to be useful, and built on studies you judged rather than simply collected. Treat what follows as being about your own sport searches and reading, whether in sport science, coaching, management or therapy, not about study in the abstract.
